title: inventoryadjusted.completed v1
description: An inventory adjustment has completed. Emitted wherever an inventory_adjustments row is finalised: admin review approval, direct adjustment, CSV import, the Pipe B inbound inventory-sync path, and alongside cycle_count.adjusted on the cycle-count branch. The entity-prefixed name connectors filter on; replaces the retired adjustment.applied/1 event. Cycle-count variance details still ride on cycle_count.adjusted/1; this event carries the canonical adjustment shape regardless of source. Aggregate: inventory_adjustment.

applied_by_user_external_id.description: Actor who effectuated the change. Null on the Pipe B inbound inventory-sync path, which is system-driven and carries no Sentry user identity. At admin review_adjustments this is the approver; at direct_adjustment / cycle-count approval / CSV import it is the caller.
